'''Pokémon Omega Ruby Crimson Passion and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire Indigo Wisdom''' (Japanese: '''ポケモンオメガルビー紅き情熱・ポケモンアルファサファイア藍き英知''') are two [[Pokémon manga]] created by Hatha Shingo. The Crimson Passion and Indigo Wisdom stories run parallel to each other and star twin brothers named {{OBP|Omega|CPIW}} and {{OBP|Alpha|CPIW}}. Each brother sets out to capture {{p|Groudon}} and {{p|Kyogre}}, respectively. The two stories were collected together in one volume.
